name: Café Sabor Shredded Chicken Enchiladas or Smothered Burrito (Mild Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Garden City / Bear Lake & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Soft tortillas filled with tender shredded chicken and melted cheese with rice; safe on steady days when ordered with mild sauce on the side and no black beans.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Shredded Chicken Burrito or Enchiladas with rice only (no whole black beans), sauce on the side, and a Lactaid for the melted cheese/sour cream.
watchOuts: Hold whole black beans and spicy salsa
Take a Lactaid for melted cheese and sour cream
